name: omniget
description: Fetch media, captions and transcripts from a pasted URL with OmniGet's tooling (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, whisper.cpp or cloud speech APIs), connect Claude Code to the OmniGet desktop app with one click, read your meetings' minutes and action items and your Microsoft Teams chats and calendar, hand tasks to your OmniGet agents when you ask, and, with the desktop app, recall and keep what OmniGet remembers about you.
